metadata.description: Wood desk, monitor, keyboard, mouse, and three books.
Small teal chair with wood legs and a raised back.
Wood bedside drawer unit with a warm stepped lampshade.
Blue watering can with an open arched handle and rising spout.
Teal water tank with a cyan stripe, gauge, and short front nozzle.
Open metal rack supporting two LED boards with pink/violet strips.
Compact standing fan with a circular housing and visible grille.
